data.title: The Baltimore
data.about:
Discover The Baltimore by Nshama, an exceptional community at Town Square Dubai offering luxurious apartments. Designed to provide a vibrant yet tranquil lifestyle, The Baltimore features spacious layouts with ample natural light, built-in wardrobes, and stylish kitchens equipped with premium German-made appliances.

Designed for an elevated lifestyle, The Baltimore at Town Square offers access to world-class facilities, including swimming pools, a gym, indoor and outdoor kids' play areas, and a BBQ area. Residents can also benefit from a multi-purpose room, recreational spaces, and even a dedicated pet washroom, ensuring comfort and convenience for all. With its prime location, modern sophistication, and community-focused amenities, The Baltimore presents an ideal opportunity for living and investing in one of Dubai’s most dynamic neighborhoods.

characteristics_module.title: The Baltimore – A Lifestyle Perfectly Crafted in Town Square Dubai
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Parkside Location: Located at the entrance of Town Square Park, offering direct access to lush green spaces and jogging trails while enjoying stunning boulevard views.
  • Versatile Apartment Options: Choose from spacious 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, thoughtfully designed to suit diverse lifestyle needs.
  • Contemporary Design: Modern interiors with porcelain flooring, large windows, and natural light-filled living spaces for a welcoming and elegant ambiance.
  • Premium Finishes: Kitchens equipped with German-made appliances and ample storage solutions, blending style with functionality.
  • Exceptional Community Living: Access to a vibrant Town Square Dubai community featuring retail outlets, restaurants, cafes, and recreational amenities like pools and gyms.
  • Flexible Payment Plan: Investor-friendly payment structure with 50% during construction and 50% on handover, making homeownership attainable.
  • Renowned Developer: Developed by Nshama, known for creating thriving communities and high-quality residential projects in Dubai.

location_tile.title: Perfectly Positioned at the Heart of Town Square Dubai – Where Connectivity Meets Serenity
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Nestled at the gateway to Town Square Park, The Baltimore at Town Square Dubai by Nshama offers a lifestyle where nature meets the city’s vibrant energy. Imagine waking up to serene boulevard views, with lush green trails just steps from your door, perfect for a morning jog or an evening stroll. Its enviable location places you within minutes of iconic landmarks like Burj Al Arab, while ensuring quick access to nearby communities such as Mudon.

  • Mudon: 17 minutes
  • Burj Al Arab: 24 minutes
  • District 2020: 20 minutes
  • Dubai Hills Mall: 20 minutes
  • DWC Airport: 25 minutes
  • Dubai International Airport: 28 minutes
  • Dubai Mall: 29 minutes
